findings.title: File uses a pickle-based format that executes code on load
findings.detail: Detected raw-pickle. Python's pickle protocol is a small program: loading it can import arbitrary modules and call arbitrary callables. This risk exists regardless of whether a malicious payload is present.
findings.remediation: Prefer safetensors or GGUF. If you must load a pickle checkpoint, use torch.load(..., weights_only=True) and load only from sources you trust.

findings.title: Pickle imports from a module with no place in a model file
findings.detail: benign_reduce.pkl: imports from process/network/interpreter modules: __builtin__.print
findings.remediation: Do not load. Prefer a safetensors build of the same model.

findings.title: Pickle contains callable-invoking opcodes
findings.detail: benign_reduce.pkl: found 1 opcode(s) of type REDUCE. Every legitimate PyTorch checkpoint also contains these, so this is context, not a verdict on its own.
findings.remediation: Use torch.load(..., weights_only=True) where loading is unavoidable, or migrate to safetensors.

findings.title: Executable format disguised with a safe-looking extension
findings.detail: Extension '.safetensors' implies safetensors, but the bytes are raw-pickle. A pickle renamed to a data-only extension is a deliberate bypass of extension-based allowlists.
findings.remediation: Do not load. Verify the file's origin and integrity.

findings.title: Pickle imports a known code-execution primitive
findings.detail: format_confusion.safetensors: the stream imports nt.system. Combined with a REDUCE-family opcode this executes on load.
findings.remediation: Treat this file as hostile. Delete it and obtain the model in safetensors or GGUF form from the publisher.

findings.detail: truncated.pkl: parsing stopped after 3 opcode(s). A stream that a parser rejects may still be partially processed by a permissive loader, and corruption here is a common fuzzing/exploitation artefact.
findings.remediation: Do not load this file. Re-download from a trusted source.

findings.remediation: Delete this archive. Do not extract or load it.
